build_multilingual_translation_task: build a multilingual translation task with multiple language pairs for simultaneous training
setup_multilingual_translation_task: setup a multilingual translation task by loading dictionaries and preparing language pairs
load_multilingual_translation_dataset: load a round-robin dataset for multiple language pairs from a data directory
train_multilingual_translation_step: run a training step that computes loss across all language pairs with gradient aggregation
infer_multilingual_translation: run inference for a single source-target language pair using a generator model
